name: mgr-production-brain
description: MGR Production Brain 1: researched production plans, prompt compilation, persistent revisions, byte-bound assets, media inspection, camera preflight, editorial drafts and motion content websites. Works with MGR BEAST and optional provider connections.

interface.longDescription: Companion to MGR BEAST with executable Node tools. Turn an idea into a production plan, preserve revisions and original assets, inspect supported media, check camera paths, assemble editorial drafts and build motion content pages before provider generation. Includes researched methods and explicit capability limits. Live rendering and provider execution require connected tools; generated quality is not certified by planning checks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MGR Production Brain with MGR BEAST to turn my idea into a researched production plan, validate continuity, and prepare model-specific prompts before generation.
